description: Owner tour checks that belong to no single venue entry. tools/venue-proposals.py tour-stops appends each one to the checklist of the named stop (a stop code from tools/probes/tour_stops.json).

checks.text: Drive down Monument Avenue: no Space Force One wreckage (wrecked cars, the flipped craft part, body bags). The debris (loc_q302_car_chase_sf1_debris, excluded in research wave 10) sits inside the always-streamed monument_av prefab, so its hidden default is unconfirmed.

Drive past the Red Peaks freeway bus stop near (1340, -816): no parked ambush truck or spike strip on the shoulder. loc_sq017_ambush was excluded in research wave 11; if the props show, add a var_truck=0 / var_spike_trap=0 toggle on #sq017_pr_truck_freeway.

Try to drive about 1.2 km south of the border to Dry Creek's protein farm: is it reachable in free roam? Research wave 11 found it intact and empty (nothing to restore, so no venue entry); its access is owner decision 48.

Go to (694, -639, 10), about 170 m from this stop. Container Freight Station bay (Panam's q103 meeting point): it reads as an ordinary freight bay, with no Panam, car or meeting dressing. Wave 12: nothing to restore, so no venue entry.

Go to (175, 560, 117), about 508 m from this stop. Columbarium (q204): both mourner crowds are present on a fresh boot (#q204_columbarium_com from the kept North Oak phase; #q204_columbarium_new_com starts active). Wave 12: nothing to restore, so no venue entry. If it is empty, owner call: re-activate #q204_columbarium_com.

Go to the shore at (-2479, 3515, 4), about 1026 m from this stop: no wrecked or burning Seamurai, debris or lift. The Boat Drinks beach (loc_sq028_beach) was excluded in wave 12; the yacht is intact in our timeline.
